subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to
stimulus: make the whole story. Only the corresponding numbers of the sentences need to be written. 18 = 8 (a) She ordered her huntsman to kill Snow White. (b) But the huntsman, missed of killing Snow White, left her in the forest. (c) They took her to their house and brought her up (d) While she was running in the forest out of fear, seven dwarfs found her. (e) As soon as he saw her, he fell in love with her. (f) Once a prince came by that forest. (g) He married her and took her to his kingdom. (h) Once a queen was jealous of the beauty of her only step-daughter named Snow White.  Section B : Writing Test (Marks 50)
